```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import sqlite3
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

sqlite_file = 'lahmansbaseballdb.sqlite'
con = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)
```

```{python}
q = '''
SELECT *
FROM batting
'''
qr = pl.read_database(q, con, infer_schema_length=None)

qr.head(2)

ba_df = (
    qr
    .with_columns(
        BA = pl.col("H") / pl.col("AB")
    )
)

ba_df[1].select("playerID", "AB", "BA")
```
